job.job_description:
About the Role

We are hiring a GenAI Engineer who can code, build, and deploy production-ready AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands-on with Python, LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and has experience in creating reusable agentic components. Youll work on integrating both OpenAI and open-source LLMs into scalable, cloud-based solutions that deliver real business value.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications and agents for automation and workflow optimization
Develop reusable agentic components aligned with our tech stack
Work hands-on with Python, LangChain, and LlamaIndex
Leverage OpenAI APIs and open-source LLMs (eg, GPT, LLaMA, Gemini, etc
Prepare and process structured/unstructured datasets for fine-tuning or training models
Deploy scalable solutions on cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and manage the lifecycle with MLOps best practices
Stay up to date with the latest GenAI/LLM advancements and apply them to real-world problems

Qualifications & Skills



5-10 years total experience, with 4+ years in NLP/LLMs
Strong Python coding skills (must be hands-on)
Proven experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and other agentic frameworks
Ability to design reusable, production-grade AI components
Practical experience with both proprietary (OpenAI) and open-source LLMs
Experience deploying solutions on Azure (preferred) or other major cloud platforms
Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on building, not theory
Java FSE with AngularJS react JS and any AWS (EC2,S3,Cloud Watch)
